_note: Sec.10's four families, transcribed. Bands live here, not in Python -- same reasoning as Phase 1's reference distributions (Sec.10). Every band_low/band_high traces to a sentence in docs/design/phase-2-manager-minds.md Sec.10; `source` cites it. Folds in architect round-8 report Sec.9's three corrections (M9 no longer vacuous; M1's measured_at narrowed to the boundaries the phase graph actually enforces a ceiling at, with post_waivers floor-only; M18 correctly reports red) plus the *further* refinement T7a2's own build/critic history (docs/ledger/phase-2.md rounds on T7a2/apron2-fix) made to M1/M2's exact measurement points, since that history postdates round 8 and is the real, currently-passing test suite's own ground truth -- see tests/unit/tools/gm_harness/test_season.py's invariant-1/invariant-2 tests for the authoritative semantics this file's M1/M2 entries transcribe. `roster_min`/`roster_max` are carried here as params (round 7's own schema table left M1's params column blank) because metrics.py is contractually pure (tuple[RunRecord, ...] and nothing else) and cannot read seeds/cap_settings.json itself -- the two constants are the real, fixed values that file carries (14/15), never re-derived.

metrics.name: roster_size_bounds
metrics.statistic: raw roster body count per (season, team) at the boundaries the phase graph actually enforces a ceiling at, plus a floor-only check at post_waivers
metrics.source: phase-2-manager-minds.md Sec.10 Family 1 item 1 (as corrected by architect round 8 Sec.9 item 2 and T7a2's own critic-round-2 refinement)
metrics.rationale: The real NBA rule -- and the phase graph's own WAIVERS-immediately-before-PRESEASON edge -- binds the roster ceiling on opening night, not in July: post_draft/free_agency_open/season_end are excluded because carrying extra bodies there is correct domain behavior, not a bug. post_waivers is floor-only because a player expiring exactly this season stays physically rostered through post_waivers (nothing evicts a contract mid-season); the ceiling half of what WAIVERS actually bounds -- next-season occupancy -- only becomes a raw, observable count at the FOLLOWING season's own PRESEASON, which is why PRESEASON is in the ceiling-and-floor set for every season including 2+, not just season 1.

metrics.name: apron2_budget
metrics.statistic: count of (boundary, team) pairs with used > apron_2, at the 5 boundaries this invariant is currently real at

known_gap.reason: dba2/managers/decisions/signing.py and gm_service.py's free-agency legality path never check a post-signing team's used against apron_2 at all (grep-confirmed: apron_2/apron2 appears zero times in signing.py), unlike trade.py::_check_legality's own real apron_2 gate for trades. A team can legally combine several individually-legal free-agency offers (each passing its own room/exception-ceiling check) into a post-signing total that breaches apron_2 -- confirmed on the real harness at rng_seed=1, team 14 (apron2_room=+4,650,523 at free_agency_open, apron2_room=-12,759,862 at season_end, from 3 individually-legal signings). Disclosed and out of scope for this slice (a signing.py/gm_service.py fix, symmetric to trade.py's existing gate) -- reported here, not hidden or silently absorbed into a weaker invariant, and never counted toward GO/NO-GO.

metrics.rationale: used <= apron_2 at every phase boundary, except the 2 boundaries the disclosed signing.py gap above genuinely reaches -- which are reported, not gated, so a real free-agency-legality fix (not this slice's job) has something honest to close against.

metrics.name: asset_conservation
metrics.statistic: check_trade_conservation violation count across every executed trade
metrics.rationale: No player on two rosters, no pick owned twice, nothing created or destroyed by a trade -- checked per-trade at execution time (season.py's own runtime check), not reconstructed post-hoc.

metrics.name: no_double_active_contract
metrics.statistic: count of players with contract_count_by_player > 1 at any boundary
metrics.rationale: The guard roster_service.sign already enforces, checked league-wide across every recorded boundary.

metrics.name: decision_record_reconstruction
metrics.statistic: count of emitted DecisionRecords that fail .reconstructs() to 1e-6
metrics.rationale: Every DecisionRecord's terms must sum to its reported score within 1e-6, counted at emission time by season.py's own _emit funnel.

metrics.name: determinism
metrics.statistic: byte-for-byte diff of jsonl_lines between two independent runs of the same rng_seed
metrics.rationale: The same league seed and phase sequence must produce byte-identical DecisionRecord JSONL. Requires validate_gm.py to run seed 0 twice (--determinism-check, default on) and hand both RunRecords to compute_m6 -- SKIP (not counted) if no duplicate-seed pair is present in the supplied runs.

metrics.name: capped_out_bare_roster_share
metrics.statistic: share of team-seasons ending with room < 0 AND top-8 mean overall < 70, measured at season_end
metrics.rationale: The roadmap's own named failure mode (capped out with a bare roster), stated as a number: <=10% of team-seasons (<=3 of 30 in a single-season reading).

metrics.name: committed_salary_share_mean
metrics.statistic: league-mean committed_salary / salary_cap, measured at season_end
metrics.rationale: Split from M8b (round 7 Sec.6.2 item 8) because one band entry cannot express both a mean-in-range condition and a below-threshold-count condition.

metrics.name: committed_salary_share_floor_count
metrics.statistic: mean, across every (seed, season) cell, of the count of teams with committed_salary / salary_cap < 0.80, measured at season_end
metrics.rationale: "No more than 6 teams below 0.80" is a per-season statement -- summing across every season of a run would double-count the same team -- so this bands a per-(seed, season) cell count, not a run-wide total. Decision P2-35 (architect rounds 16 Sec.3 F4 / 17 Sec.2): the cross-cell aggregator is the mean, not the max. A max over cells is monotone non-decreasing in the number of cells, and validate_gm.py:233 derives seed i from the base seed and index alone, so a larger run's cells are a strict superset of a smaller one's -- the old instrument made the test harder the more evidence was gathered. The mean is unbiased at every cell count and is algebraically 30 x the pooled share of team-seasons below 0.80, i.e. the same family of statistic as M8a directly above. The per-cell maximum, the full per-cell histogram, and the count/share of cells at or above band_high are all still computed and reported in detail -- they are diagnostics, not the gate. Known residual: the mean is invariant in the seed count but not in the season count (the underlying per-season counts drift upward across a run), so exit_criterion.min_seasons must be treated as an operating point for this metric, not merely a floor -- see Sec.10 item 8's round-17 note.

metrics.name: dead_cap_share
metrics.statistic: sum(dead_cap) / sum(salary_cap) across every team, pooled across runs and seasons, measured at post_waivers
metrics.source: phase-2-manager-minds.md Sec.10 Family 2 item 9 (round 8 Sec.9 item 1's correction)
metrics.rationale: No longer vacuous as of T7a2 (the WAIVERS decision, architect round 8 Sec.7): dead_cap_by_team_season now carries real charges from real cuts, and this metric belongs in the GO/NO-GO count -- round 7's original vacuous=true entry was correct only before T7a2 landed. Round 8's own first-cut estimate (~2.5%, not to be trusted blindly) is a sanity check for the real measured figure, not a substitute for it.

metrics.name: room_buyers_count
metrics.statistic: mean, across seeds, of the count of teams that are 'room buyers' at free_agency_open, in the run's steady-state season only (season index params.resolves_at_season) -- NOT pooled across seasons (Decision P2-40). A team is a room buyer when room > n_open * mle_amount_this_season (Decision P2-46, the slot-relative form), n_open = max(0, params.roster_max - row.roster_count), mle_amount_this_season = params.mle_amount_base * (salary_cap_this_season / params.salary_cap_base) -- replacing the flat room > 0.15 * salary_cap threshold
metrics.rationale: A market with no buyers, or with nothing but buyers, is broken in either direction. Gated on the steady-state season (architect round 15: zero surviving generator vintage by season 5) rather than pooled across seasons, pinned to exit_criterion.min_seasons so the operating point cannot drift from Decision P2-22's own floor (Decision P2-40, architect round 21 Sec.3). The gate reads capsheet_with_holds_by_team, not capsheet_by_team (Decision P2-41, architect round 22 Sec.4.1): Decision P2-39 made run_free_agency's own affordability basis hold-inclusive, so a hold-free gate measured a quantity the model no longer decided on; params.holds_basis makes this basis data, not an implicit code fact, and the gate hard-SKIPs (never silently falls back to the hold-free basis) on any boundary predating Slice 19-A. The pooled mean survives in detail["pooled_mean_across_runs_seasons"] for historical comparability, still on the hold-free basis (capsheet_by_team, not capsheet_with_holds_by_team) -- but, as of Decision P2-46, using the same slot-relative counting rule as the gate, not the old flat-percentage rule (round 28 Sec.4/Sec.6: this decision redefines what 'room buyer' means everywhere it is counted, not merely which basis the gate reads). params.mle_amount_base ($14,104,000) and params.salary_cap_base ($154,647,000) are the real, unscaled seed anchors -- compute_m10 is contractually pure and cannot import seeds/cap_settings.json, so they are carried here literally, the same treatment M1's params.roster_min/roster_max already get. params.roster_max duplicates M1's own literal (15) rather than reaching into M1's bands entry, keeping M10's params entry self-contained (M1's own duplication of the seed constant is the precedent, not cross-metric coupling). room_share_threshold (0.15) is removed from this params block, not retained: nothing reads it FROM HERE any longer (the gated computation, the per_season hold-free computation, and the hold-inclusive computation all moved to the slot-relative rule), so keeping it here would be dead config a future reader could mistake for still load-bearing. The literal 0.15 itself is not deleted from the codebase, though: it is hardcoded directly in metrics.py's _m10_is_room_buyer_flat_threshold_v0, which reports two old-rule twins (detail["pooled_mean_across_runs_seasons_flat_threshold_v0"], detail["hold_inclusive_mean_flat_threshold_v0"]) that never feed value/gated_cells -- the joinability fix Decision P2-46's own text requires, in the identical pattern Decision P2-35 (max_over_cells) and Decision P2-40 (pooled_mean_across_runs_seasons/hold_inclusive_mean) already used.

metrics.name: star_talent_acquisition_ratio
metrics.statistic: (sum acquisitions overall>=80 in CONTEND/WIN_NOW cohort / sum team-seasons in that cohort) / (same for REBUILD)

It goes stale on a gm_tuning_version bump exactly as item 14's se_precertified does, and -- unlike item 14's -- it also silently survives a mechanism change that bumps no version (Slice 26-A was such a change and moved item 16 by ~1.3 points at 3 seeds), which is why it is advisory and never a gate. `margin_in_se` answers whether a run at THIS run's own seed count is a reliable read of this metric; `margin_in_se_at_sd_seeds` (populated only when sd_source is precertified) instead answers how far THIS run's own value sits from the band judged against the metric's best-established large-sample dispersion -- see Decision P2-47 in docs/design/phase-2-manager-minds.md for the actual 45-seed VALUE measurements, which this block does not and cannot reproduce.

metrics.rationale: Same Acquisition records as M11, pooled across the whole run.

metrics.name: defense_first_group_mean_gap
metrics.statistic: mean per-player (ON_BALL_DEF + TEAM_DEF) group mean, defense_first roster mean minus league-wide mean, at the end of season params.resolves_at_season

gated_value_precertified.source: phase-3-inter-manager-society.md Sec.9/Sec.11 step 9's Family-3 measurability fix (Decision P3-47, docs/ledger/phase-3.md rounds 36-38): step 9's real 3-seed x 5-season gate failed M16 specifically on sampling noise from a band that itself sits inside its own 45-seed measurement noise (M16 0.34 SE above floor, M12 0.83 SE) -- the user ruled Family 3 (M11-M16) gates on the already-measured 45-seed skip-games corpus instead, amending Decision P3-32 for these six metrics only. Value measured by tools/precertify_family3.py over artifacts/validation_gm/m14_seeds_v3's existing 45 pickles (gm_tuning_version=3, post step 4's negotiation loop going live), re-verified against this same value after Decision P3-47 step 1 pinned this metric's own season index (params.resolves_at_season) -- a byte-identical no-op at this corpus's seasons=5, so the value is unchanged from the figure already cited in params.precision.source. Supersedes step 9's own 3-seed real-games reading as the GATED value for this metric only -- the live 3-seed reading is still computed every run and reported in detail['live_reading'], never silently dropped, and a stale or absent citation falls back to it loudly rather than SKIPping (Decision P3-37's discipline). **Re-precertified 2026-09-13 (Decision P4-42): behavior_scope=2, measured fresh over artifacts/validation_gm/m14_seeds_v4_phase4_agency under real Phase 4 agency behavior -- see M11's own citation for the full explanation, restated once there rather than four times.**

precision.se_threshold_basis: Sec.10 item 14's own rule generalized: (band_low - null_value) / 2, i.e. the band must sit >= 2 SE above the no-differentiation null. Reproduces item 14's own shipped 0.75 exactly at band_low 1.5, null 0.
precision.source: phase-3-inter-manager-society.md Sec.11 step 8 re-precertification, docs/ledger/phase-3.md; measured via delete-one jackknife over artifacts/validation_gm/m14_seeds_v3/'s 45 pickles (gm_tuning_version=3, post step 4's negotiation loop going live); value at 45 seeds 1.559692, sd_across_seeds 0.174422. Supersedes the prior gm_tuning_version=2 citation (orchestrator round 43: value 1.734013, sd_across_seeds 0.155940), which went stale when step 4 bumped GM_TUNING_VERSION 2 -> 3.

metrics.rationale: Computed per player as the pooled mean over the real, committed RATING_GROUPS['ON_BALL_DEF'] (4) + RATING_GROUPS['TEAM_DEF'] (9) = 13 fields -- season.py's own module docstring already found and disclosed the report's '12 fields' arithmetic is stale against the real table; this band follows the actual two full groups, not a trimmed-to-12 subset. Decision P3-47 step 1 pins the gated reading to a fixed season index (params.resolves_at_season, mirroring Decision P2-40's M10 precedent) rather than 'whichever season came last' (run.seasons[-1]) -- a fixed index is invariant in run length, verified a byte-identical no-op at seasons=5 (every corpus this band gates on today) before landing.

metrics.name: draft_board_divergence
metrics.statistic: star_maxer's own-board match rate minus egalitarian's own-board match rate, over 100 seeded monoculture 30-slot drafts
metrics.rationale: Needs no season simulation -- its own --only-metric-17 fast path in validate_gm.py. Compares each philosophy's actual run_draft pick against that same philosophy's own prospect_value_for board (need_bonus zeroed) at every slot, matching more often for star_maxer than egalitarian by design (fit_sens is the dial this isolates). Deliberately excluded from Decision P3-47's gated_value_precertified mechanism (M11-M13/M15/M16 and M14 get one, M17 does not): M17 takes no `runs` argument at all (Decision P2-47/RS3's own established scope) and has zero seed-count variance to precertify against -- there is no live-vs-45-seed sampling-noise question for this metric to answer.

metrics.name: trades_per_season
metrics.statistic: trades per season league-wide, averaged over seasons and seeds, reported per (seed, season)
metrics.rationale: The floor is the important half -- zero trades in even one (seed, season) is the deadlock failure this metric exists to catch, and forces a FAIL regardless of the run-wide mean.

metrics.name: mutual_accept_share
metrics.statistic: sum(mutual_accepts) / sum(packages_evaluated), pooled across runs/seasons/windows
metrics.rationale: mutual_accepts / packages_evaluated, not executions / packages_evaluated -- the interpretation call round 7 Sec.6.2 item 19 resolves explicitly.

metrics.name: max_team_trade_share
metrics.statistic: max, over any (seed, season, team), of that team's share of the season's trade participations
metrics.rationale: Degenerate-arbitrage check -- no single team should account for more than 25% of a season's trades. Structurally unsatisfiable in the [12, 24) trades/season region given MAX_TRADES_PER_TEAM_PER_WINDOW=3 x 2 windows -- a named step-11 lever, not a bug in this band.

metrics.name: retrade_loop
metrics.statistic: count of (player, team-pair) that trade back within the immediately-following trade window
metrics.rationale: Unfalsifiable as literally written -- there is no calendar in the harness, and run_trade_window's own consumed_players set already makes an intra-window repeat structurally impossible. Reinterpreted as 'no ordered pair (A, B) re-trades the same player back in the immediately following trade window' and rendered PASS (interpreted), never a plain green, and excluded from the GO/NO-GO count.

metrics.name: win_total_sd
metrics.statistic: mean, across 5 seasons, of the standard deviation of the 30 teams' win totals within that season
metrics.rationale: Neither a superteam singularity nor forced parity. The only metric requiring real games -- SKIPs (not counted) under --skip-games, and --skip-games can therefore never produce a GO verdict.

metrics.name: counter_open_rate
metrics.statistic: negotiations reaching >= 1 counter round / negotiations opened (every seed package opens exactly one negotiation, including illegal and round-0-accept ones)
metrics.rationale: Uncounted PERMANENTLY (Decision P3-43, part 3) -- no honest band width can make this pass. The statistic IS c (the share of seed packages whose round-0 turn opens a counter), and step 1's census measured it far below any defensible floor at the shipped COUNTER_BAND_MULT=3.0 (0.0344 at MULT=3.0 against a 0.05 floor; nothing clears the floor until MULT ~= 5, which the design's own clawback identity proves is metric-gaming). Correcting the denominator to the statically-feasible population does not rescue it either (0.0580 against the 0.05 floor, reachable only at MULT=infinity). A rate over a denominator ~98% of which cannot contribute is measuring market composition, not the protocol. Reported alongside the live five-cell outcome census and the live EXPIRED:stalled count (detail) so a reader can see the market composition this metric is actually reading. M23' (id M23p) is the counted presence gate that replaces it -- do not restore this metric's counted_in_go as a 'fix'; that is the exact mistake this rationale exists to prevent.

metrics.name: counter_construction_hit_rate
metrics.statistic: counters admitted by build_counter / counter opportunities opened (of the negotiations whose round-0 turn produced a COUNTER stance, the share build_counter actually returns a package for)
metrics.source: phase-3-inter-manager-society.md Sec.9.3, Sec.11 step 1d (round 23), corrected round 24 (B24-1)
metrics.rationale: M23' replaces M23 as the counted Family-5 presence gate (Decision P3-43 part 3). The band is FROZEN, not fitted: step 1d measured r=0.2040 (exact feasibility rate at MULT=3.0, pooled over 50 windows, 5 seeds x 5 seasons, --rng-seed 2, real _probe_package and real evaluate_trade, BEFORE build_counter existed) with cross-seed sample_sd=0.0138852. M23' is gated at THREE seeds (Decision P3-32/Sec.11 step 18: >= 3 seeds x >= 5 seasons), so the sample SD is projected to SE_3 = 0.0138852 / sqrt(3) = 0.0080166 -- NOT the 5-seed SE_5=0.0062096 round 23 mistakenly used. Floor = r - 2*SE_3 = 0.187967, rounded DOWN to 0.18; ceiling = r + 4*SE_3 = 0.236066 (2 SE sampling tolerance plus a further 2 SE diagnostic-tolerance margin, since a reading above the ceiling can mean the live constructor legitimately outperforms the census rather than a defect), rounded UP to 0.24. The retired provisional [0.08, 0.30], the retired closed-form comparand 0.240, and round 23's own [0.19, 0.23] (built on the wrong seed count's SE) are all superseded by this row. SKIPs when zero counter opportunities open (Decision P3-37's guard) -- its reading on a counters-off/mechanism-absent corpus.

metrics.name: counter_closed_executions
metrics.statistic: count of executed trades whose negotiation closed at round_index >= 1, pooled across seeds
metrics.rationale: Falsifies exactly 'counters exist but never close anything.' An a priori existence gate, set without measuring the run it gates (Decision P3-33) -- it needs no band derivation and cannot slide. Weak by construction (one closed counter in six hundred trades passes it); the conversion share is reported in detail and never gated.

metrics.name: negotiation_depth_violations
metrics.statistic: negotiations exceeding MAX_NEGOTIATION_ROUNDS, terminating in a non-terminal state, or carrying a turn with no situation token
metrics.rationale: Family-1-grade hard invariant -- Decision P3-19's 'every turn carries exactly one situation token, total over the round cap' promise made mechanical. Passes vacuously if no negotiation ever runs (counters off), which is why M23' exists beside it as a presence gate that CAN fail on absence.

metrics.name: phrase_fallback_share
metrics.statistic: fallback-template selections / total selections
metrics.rationale: counted_in_go: true as of step 16 -- the phrase/dialogue mechanism (services/phrase_service.py, seeds/gm_phrases.json, wired live into the negotiation loop at step 15) is now real and measured. SKIPs (never a bare 0/0) whenever total_selections == 0 (Decision P3-37's guard), which is every reading before step 16's own dialogue-enabled validate_gm.py run (m14_seeds_v2, steps 7/9/12/13/14). A high share means the library's triggers do not match the real deal distribution; reject_illegal's own fallback rate is checked separately (step 15/16, detail.per_situation) since that one situation alone can consume most of this budget.

metrics.name: voice_differentiation
metrics.statistic: Decision P3-49 (paired difference): tv_live - tv_control, where tv_live is the total-variation distance between the template-id distributions of star_maxer and egalitarian GMs on the real library, and tv_control is the identical statistic measured on the SAME real corpus's negotiation trajectory (Decision P3-20's byte-identical frames) run against a with_philosophies_disabled variant of the library. Superseded the original (withdrawn) bare tv_live reading, which a null-control pass showed would falsely PASS a library with zero philosophy-exclusive content -- see phase-3-inter-manager-society.md Sec.9.1's dated correction.
metrics.rationale: counted_in_go: true as of step 16 -- same mechanism-now-real reason as M26. band_low=0.125 is unchanged (Decision P3-31): it was always a derivation of the philosophies-allow-list's own exclusive_mass_share structural guarantee, and now applies correctly to the paired difference it was actually derived from, not to tv_live alone. SKIPs when either cohort's selection count is 0 in EITHER arm (Decision P3-37's guard), and hard-SKIPs on --no-control-check (the control arm is non-optional for a paired-difference metric, mirroring M28's control_totals is None rule). params.escalation_threshold (0.0625, half the band floor) now gates a within-cohort split-half A/A reading (tools/validate_gm.py: each of star_maxer/egalitarian's own POOLED template distribution binomial-thinned in half within the control arm -- dated correction, a later fix round: this was originally a team-id split of each cohort's own teams, withdrawn because it concentrated real cross-team situation-mix heterogeneity into one half at only 5 teams/cohort and read 2-3x over this threshold; the binomial-thinning split isolates pure sampling noise instead, matching what the analytic null (Sec.9.1) models) -- a genuine sampling-noise-only null, repointed from the original cross-cohort control reading (Decision P3-31/P3-37), which Decision P3-49 found is contaminated by trigger-based, philosophy-correlated selection (not noise) and is now load-bearing INSIDE the metric's own paired difference instead. Exceeding the threshold means the noise-only null itself is not clean at this event rate and the phase escalates rather than sliding the band, never gated as part of this metric's own pass/fail.

metrics.name: adaptation_decision_flips
metrics.statistic: min over the three adaptation channels of that channel's count of decision sites where the memory-shaded outcome differed from the shade=0 baseline, pooled across seeds; channel 1's count is its up plus down branch counts, carried separately
metrics.source: phase-3-inter-manager-society.md Sec.9/Sec.9.2, Decision P3-36/P3-38/P3-40, Sec.11 step 17
metrics.rationale: counted_in_go: true as of step 17 -- channel 1 (the per-partner target-count ladder, Decision P3-40) is now built, so all three adaptation channels have real decision sites and Decision P3-37's SKIP guard is structurally unreachable from this step forward. `value` is min(ch3_flips, ch2_flips, ch1_up_flips + ch1_down_flips) -- min over the THREE CHANNELS, channel 1's own count being its two branches SUMMED (a critic-found fix to this metric's own prior build, which wrongly took a 4-way min over four independent branch counts -- that formula could zero `value` on the exact 'threshold unreachable at this event rate' outcome this band's own conjunct already handles correctly via its escape clause, turning an honestly-passing conjunct outcome into a failed min; the fix is provably >= the old formula at every input, so it can only turn a FAIL into a PASS, never the reverse). `extra_pass` is now BOTH halves of this band's own two-part conjunct, ANDed together: (i) Decision P3-38's reachability-conditional clause per branch -- flips >= 1 OR reachability == 0 -- so a branch that was never reachable (its own predicate never held, or held only where a higher-precedence branch's did too, Decision P3-40's ladder) passes on the escape clause rather than manufacturing a red gate out of an honestly rare or structurally unreachable branch (§11 step 17's own derivation: ch1-down is expected at only ~16-20 sites across a whole exit gate); (ii) the M29-control-pass conjunct §9.2's table describes -- every channel that has decision sites on the M29 control pass reads exactly 0 flips there, per branch (ch3/ch1_up/ch1_down require a REAL zero, sites > 0 and flips == 0; ch2's own clause is sites == 0 or flips == 0, since its vacuous zero -- build_counter never runs at max_negotiation_rounds=0 -- is the expected, correct reading there, per §9.2's own carve-out). This second half was reported-only through step 17's initial build (a genuine, disclosed finding at the time: state.head_to_head accumulated real data across the control run's own multiple seasons regardless of max_negotiation_rounds, so channels 1 and 3 both measurably read nonzero flips there on the committed Decision P3-29(b) baseline seed -- 130/47/20 respectively -- not the 0 the table's head_to_head=None premise assumed, until Decision P3-48's reader-side memory-suppression fix made the premise true); it is now a real, gated conjunct half, and `control_totals is None` (--no-control-check) is a hard SKIP rather than a silent partial pass, mirroring compute_m29's own identical rule. Every channel's real, non-vacuous head_to_head=None zero is ALSO established independently by a dedicated unit test (already true for channels 2/3 before this step; added for channel 1 this step), so this conjunct is never the sole proof of a real zero. This same finding is why run_seed(max_negotiation_rounds=0) stopped reproducing seeds/gm_decision_log_digest.json byte-for-byte when channel 1 first landed -- channel 1's decision site sits upstream of respond()'s round-0 short-circuit, unlike channels 2/3, so its real memory-driven candidate generation genuinely perturbed the digest. Decision P3-48 (the reader-side head_to_head_enabled flag, threaded to every max_negotiation_rounds=0 call site including this control pass) restored byte-identity by suppressing memory at construction time rather than by regenerating the committed baseline -- both previously-broken tests pass again, so this is a fixed defect, not a standing disclosed regression. Channel 1's flip_rate is not an inertness statistic (it is identically 1.0 by construction on a wired build, ch1_up.flips == ch1_up.reachability and ch1_down.flips == ch1_down.reachability exactly, per the ladder identity, nit 2 round 8) -- reported instead as an equality assertion in `detail`, asserted with no tolerance by validate_gm.py::_assert_m28_step17_invariants, which also raises on either of the triage gate's two violations (Decision P3-41: far_rejects_observed >= 1 with channel1_down_max_observed == 0.0, or m18_trades_executed >= 1 with channel1_up_max_observed == 0.0 -- the never-written-field signature).

metrics.name: control_equivalence
metrics.statistic: Both of Decision P3-29's comparisons, folded into one mismatch count: (b) the digest comparison on a control pass at max_negotiation_rounds=0, and (a) -- wired at step 9, when the run's own config matches the committed Phase-2 baseline's shape -- a value-scoped comparison of this run's own report against docs/ledger/phase-2-exit-gate-report.json. See known_gap for why the combined count is reported, not gated.

known_gap.reason: Decision P3-46 (step 9, real 3x5 with-games run): wiring comparison (a) exactly as Decision P3-29(a) and step 7's own deferral specified is CORRECT, and it exposed a structural fact rather than a bug -- comparison (a) diffs a mechanism-ON run against the mechanism-OFF Phase-2 baseline at exact/byte value equality, so it can only read 0 mismatches if Phase 3's negotiation mechanism changes nothing at all. On the real step-9 run it read 41 mismatches, decomposed and independently reproduced: 3 unavoidable (the new Family-5 metric ids, go/go_reason text), 18 from the already-disclosed GM_TUNING_VERSION 2->3 precision-citation drift (step 8), and 20 from real, intended trade-volume/cap/free-agency ripple effects the negotiation mechanism is supposed to cause (M2/M7/M8a/M8b/M9/M10/M11-M22) -- none a code defect. A `<=0`-violations gate can therefore never usefully pass once the mechanism does anything, which is the same 'instrument reads red for definitional reasons, not behavioral ones' failure class Decision P3-43 already named for M23 (counter_open_rate) -- inverted (there the statistic itself was wrong; here the comparator's exactness is incompatible with a working mechanism by construction). Resolved the same way P3-43 resolved M23: `counted_in_go: false`, permanently, mirroring that precedent exactly. Comparison (b) alone (the digest check, which IS validly exact since max_negotiation_rounds=0 nullifies the mechanism by construction) would still be a real, usefully-gated invariant on its own -- but this metric's own shape folds both comparisons into one count before `compute_m29` ever sees them, so demoting only comparison (a) without a further code split was not available as an option at this decision point; the whole metric moves to uncounted rather than partially. Both comparisons' diffs are still computed and printed on every matching-shape run, for a human to read -- this decision removes it from the gate, not from the report.

metrics.source: phase-3-inter-manager-society.md Sec.9 Family 5, Decision P3-29, Decision P3-46
metrics.rationale: Family-1-grade in intent, but permanently uncounted per Decision P3-46 (see known_gap) -- comparison (b) alone would be validly exact (at max_negotiation_rounds=0 the negotiation loop reduces to exactly Phase 2's own accept/reject read, so a control pass at that setting must reproduce the committed seeds/gm_decision_log_digest.json baseline byte-for-byte), but this metric's own value folds comparison (a) in alongside it, and comparison (a) cannot pass on a live mechanism. Runs as an added control pass in the same shape as the existing determinism_* passes (validate_gm.py's --control-check, default on). SKIPs when the control pass was not run this invocation (--no-control-check).

metrics.name: evaluations_per_package
metrics.statistic: evaluations_performed / packages_evaluated
metrics.rationale: The cost governor, with a derived ceiling. Baseline is exactly 2.0 today (both round-0 evaluate_trade calls, no counter ever built). 3.2 is 1.60x that -- Sec.13.3 shows this is a 1.073x whole-run with-games multiplier and a 1.42x skip-games one. This, not M23, is the operative cost bound on the negotiation protocol.

metrics.name: agency_request_rate
metrics.statistic: pooled share of every (checkpoint, player) observation whose RequestState is anything other than content
metrics.strength: presence-and-plausibility floor, not a differentiation test
metrics.source: phase-4-media-and-player-agency.md Decision P4-35, Sec.11 Stage C step 14, band re-derived by Decision P4-83 (round 7)
metrics.rationale: Decision P4-35's own stated null: what share of players would cross a threshold with the mechanism absent is zero by construction, so this band is a presence check, not a two-sided comparison -- agency_enabled=False SKIPs (SeasonRecord.agency_request_state_counts stays empty), it never reads a false 0.0 pass. **Decision P4-83 (critic B4 fix): band_low below was previously derived from rng_for(1, 'validate_gm', 'seed', i) -- the exact seed root tools/validate_gm.py defaults to -- which is the run this band then gates, a direct violation of Decision P4-34's own rule. Re-derived from an independent seed root the default gate invocation never uses.** Independent measurement, verified directly this round (root seed 7, otherwise identical shape -- 3 seeds x 5 seasons x 15 players/team, skip-games): 0.0016 (29 of 18000 pooled checkpoint-player observations; 13 total RequestState-ladder transitions pooled across every player, max 1 for any single player -- see M32). band_low=0.0004 is set well below that independent measurement (roughly a quarter of it, the same margin the original, now-superseded derivation used) so ordinary seed-to-seed variance does not trip a real, working mechanism. The original, circular measurement is retained here rather than deleted, labeled as what it was: root seed 1 (the default gate seed), post-Stage-C, verified directly this round to read 0.002 (36 of 18000 observations, 13 ladder transitions pooled, max 1 for any single player) -- matching both the critic's own report and the independently-measured root-seed-7 corpus's own 13-transition reading above. Decision P4-81's OWN separate, PRE-Stage-C measurement on that same corpus shape (before P4-16/P4-17 existed to read anything from the ladder) read 10 ladder transitions / 20 unsettled-player-checkpoints, a different quantity from either post-Stage-C reading and not to be conflated with them (nit 4 fix -- an earlier draft of this rationale cited the pre-Stage-C 10/20 figure and the post-Stage-C 36 figure in the same sentence as if they were the same measurement). First-draft, expected to be swept once a larger corpus is measured, per P4-9/P4-35's own posture on every Phase 4 coefficient.

metrics.name: agency_max_ladder_transitions
metrics.statistic: max, over every player in every run's own last-season cumulative snapshot, of that player's RequestState-ladder transition count for the whole run
metrics.strength: churn bound -- the direct measurement of whether hysteresis works
metrics.source: phase-4-media-and-player-agency.md Decision P4-35, Sec.11 Stage C step 14, re-verified by Decision P4-83 (round 7)
metrics.rationale: Decision P4-35: 'a player may not oscillate across the ladder more than N times in a season -- the direct measurement of whether hysteresis works.' agency_enabled=False SKIPs (SeasonRecord.agency_cumulative_transition_count_by_player stays empty), never a false 0.0 pass. **Decision P4-83 (critic B4 fix): re-measured on the same independent-seed-root corpus M31's band was re-derived from (root seed 7, not the default gate seed 1), since M32's own original citation was measured on the same self-referential run M31's was.** Independent measurement, verified directly this round: max of exactly 1 transition for any single player across the whole 5-season run (13 total transitions pooled across every player, none concentrated on one player). The original root-seed-1 measurement (max 1, 13 transitions pooled, verified directly this round -- matching both the original citation and the critic's own report) is retained as corroboration, not superseded -- both readings agree on the max, which is the only figure this band actually gates on. band_high=3 gives real headroom above the measured 1 while staying far below the 10 transitions (2 checkpoints/season x 5 seasons) a fully-broken hysteresis gate could structurally produce for one player -- first-draft, expected to be swept once a larger corpus is measured.

metrics.name: media_fallback_share
metrics.statistic: fallback_stories / stories_total, pooled from the media corpus's live arm's own pre-computed split (Decision P4-102, generation-time, never re-derived at metric time)
metrics.strength: structural ceiling, derived from the library's own weights and repeat penalty
metrics.source: phase-4-media-and-player-agency.md Decision P4-96, amended by P4-102/P4-104, Sec.11 Stage D step 20
metrics.rationale: This library cannot read below 0.3333 under any trigger regime (P(fallback) = 1.0 / (2.0 + 1.0) with no prior uses, the one-dedicated-per-eligible-pair authoring convention) -- M26's 0.20 cap is not transferable. band_high=0.65 means roughly m in [0.36, 0.48] admissible (m = the share of real selections landing on a trigger-missed/fallback-only pair) at the repeat penalty's real realized draw depths, never its 0.5 limiting asymptote. media_corpus=None SKIPs (Decision P4-34), matching compute_m26's stories_total == 0 guard exactly. **First real reading (committed artifacts/media_corpus.json, Decision P4-107): 381/433 = 0.8799, a FAIL pre-authorized in advance (Decision P4-96's own 'expected and pre-authorized as an authoring finding') -- b is unmeasurable on this corpus (every ungated_kind reads zero selections, Decision P4-104's b_provenance='modeled'), m reports as the bracket [0.820, 0.848], and the directly-measured m_lower_bound_direct (needs no b at all) reads 0.573 alone. The remedy is authoring (aligning gated dedicated templates' trigger thresholds with pulse.py's own emission thresholds, and building the producer gap Decision P4-107's Stage D step 21 scopes), never re-banding (Decision P2-35's rule, quoted in P4-33).**

metrics.name: media_voice_differentiation
metrics.statistic: paired difference tv_live - tv_control, over the analyst/historian cohort pair restricted to their three shared kinds (streak, milestone, rookie_watch), via _media_voice_differentiation_tv -> _template_distribution_tv
metrics.strength: derived band, counted_in_go governed by three per-reading conjunctive gates (Decision P4-105)
metrics.source: phase-4-media-and-player-agency.md Decision P4-97, amended by P4-105, Sec.11 Stage D step 20
metrics.rationale: band_low=0.25 derived twice (half of persona_exclusivity_floor=0.5, and directly from the exclusive-mass-share construction) and both derivations agree. media_corpus=None SKIPs (Decision P4-34); control arm is None, or either cohort reads zero restricted-kind selections in either arm, also hard-SKIPs (mirroring compute_m27's control_by_philosophy_template is None rule exactly). **counted_in_go is NOT this static true for every reading -- Decision P4-105 (amended by P4-108) governs it per-reading via three conjunctive gates (null gate, measured on BOTH arms at this row's own escalation_threshold -- four readings, 2 cohorts x 2 arms, a k<2 reading is itself a FAILURE; template-diversity gate K_live>=6 with >=2 dedicated templates per cohort; kind-coverage gate all 3 restricted kinds present in both cohorts), reported through MetricValue.counted_in_go_override. This row's own true is the metric's DESIGNED intent, not a guarantee of any one reading.** First real reading (committed artifacts/media_corpus.json): -0.0769, a FAIL, UNCOUNTED -- all three gates fail; gate 1 fails on all four of its readings (both cohorts x both arms) -- two at K < 2 in the live arm, one at K < 2 in the control arm, and control-analyst at n = 13 over the 0.0625 threshold on every seed (>= 1/n = 0.0769); the corpus is too small for this statistic independently of what it fails to cover. Gate 2 also fails (K_live=1 against 6, zero dedicated templates in either cohort) and gate 3 also fails (1 of 3 restricted kinds present in both cohorts, only streak). The FAIL does not authorize a re-authoring response (Decision P4-105 is explicit: nothing in template authoring produced it, it is a corpus finding) -- remediation is Decision P4-107's Stage D step 21 (rookie_watch + the trigger-held split), which is not gate-blocking and does not by itself clear these gates (milestone remains absent, deferred by the user's own ruling).

metrics.name: media_candidates_per_story
metrics.statistic: the MAXIMUM, over Phase, of that phase's own candidates_scored / stories_persisted ratio, each phase pooled across every cycle/season in the media corpus's live arm -- a phase is eligible only if it persisted >= top_k_per_cycle stories corpus-wide
metrics.strength: cost governor, derived from Stage A census's own measured per-cycle volume
metrics.source: phase-4-media-and-player-agency.md Decision P4-98, corrected in place round 17 (statistic: pooled -> per-Phase-maximum), Sec.11 Stage D step 20
metrics.rationale: M30's own analogue (work per unit of output), corrected from a pooled statistic (which a 4-6x FREE_AGENCY-only regression could hide) to a per-Phase maximum. band_high=15.0 is 20% above FREE_AGENCY's own census-derived ceiling reading (150.2/12=12.5). media_corpus=None SKIPs (Decision P4-34); also SKIPs when no Phase clears the top_k_per_cycle eligibility guard (a corpus too small to saturate any phase produces no reading), matching compute_m30's packages_evaluated == 0 guard shape. **First real reading: SALIENCE_FLOOR rejected zero candidates in all 54 live cycles and the per-Phase maximum reads approximately 2.8 (52/12 at the heaviest observed cycle) -- band_high=15.0 PASSes, but this is a disclosed VACUOUS PASS (register item 16, Decision P4-106): six of eleven StoryKinds (including signing_reaction, the kind FREE_AGENCY's own volume in this band's derivation rests on) have no candidate producer wired into run_media_pulse_cycle yet, so the corpus never saturates the heavy cycles this band is sized against. Ruled: band_high does not move (a band derived from a real measured volume is not wrong because the emission is currently missing, Decision P2-35) and counted_in_go stays true (the comparator is max, so a starved corpus can only produce a false PASS, never a false FAIL, and a vacuous PASS named in advance is permitted, Decision P4-34).

metrics.name: media_cycle_conservation_violations

metrics.strength: invariant, guarded three independent ways at the service layer
metrics.source: phase-4-media-and-player-agency.md Decision P4-99, Sec.11 Stage D step 20
metrics.rationale: A Family-1-grade invariant reading, guarded three separate ways at the service layer (the always-present voice-wildcard fallback, select_persona's own loud AssertionError, and Decision P4-93's no-skip persistence rule) -- a metric that only ever confirms zero is a disclosed vacuous PASS today (the same posture compute_m25 already holds), kept because the day it stops reading zero is the day one of those three mechanisms silently regressed. media_corpus=None SKIPs (Decision P4-34); also SKIPs, never a fabricated 0, when the corpus contains no cycles at all, matching compute_m32's exact guard shape. First real reading (committed artifacts/media_corpus.json): 0 -- clause (a) held in every one of the 54 live cycle rows read directly, and 20a's own per-season generation loop makes clause (b)'s cycle keys unique by construction.
